title: Estimated genome size
legend: All 34 TE species retain their phylogenetic row order. Points and intervals show estimated genome sizes in pg/1C for 21 species, derived from IOD and anchored to the D. fuscus assembly; n/a marks the 13 species without estimates. These are not independent species C-values. Conditional measurement intervals omit anchor uncertainty; no missing estimates are imputed.

title: Repeat-hit composition
legend: RepeatMasker aligned-hit-bp composition for all 34 TE species, shown as stacked bars closed across LTR, LINE, TIR, DIRS, SINE, Maverick, and Other. Other includes Unclassified. Shared order colours and phylogenetic rows are retained. These fractions describe the aligned-hit assay, not genome occupancy.

title: Repeat-order fractions
legend: LTR, LINE, and TIR fractions for all 34 species on a common 0-60% scale. Each point and stem shows the order's share of all RepeatMasker-aligned hit bp; the denominator is not restricted to these three orders. Rarer categories remain visible in panel c. These are not genome-occupancy estimates.

title: Repeat divergence profiles
legend: Zero-filled LTR, LINE, and TIR RepeatMasker profiles for all 34 species, with 0-50% sequence divergence and a common profile-height scale of 0-3% of species aligned-hit bp. Boxes and sparse rare-order columns are omitted; rarer categories remain in panel c. The full species denominator is retained; divergence is not insertion age, and hit-bp fraction is not genome occupancy.
